title: Modeling the Sacred: Considerations when Using Religious Texts in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative search and thematic coding of the ACL Anthology to identify the frequency, characterization, and application domains of specific religious texts (e.g., Bible, Quran) used as NLP datasets, alongside auditing case studies of large multilingual corpora (e.g., MADLAD-400, JW300) for religious data representation.

Qualitative analysis and literature review evaluating the representational harms, domain skews, and colonial implications of using global religious texts (such as proselytizing Christian materials) to train machine translation models for marginalized and Indigenous languages.
